attack_scenario.prerequisites: Network reachability to http://192.168.195.139/twiki/TWikiHistory.html and ability to observe or intercept HTTP traffic on the network path.
attack_scenario.abuse_narrative: An adversary with access to http://192.168.195.139/twiki/TWikiHistory.html can leverage '[OWASP ZAP] Modern Web Application' (CWE-200) to weaken application defenses or chain with adjacent service exposures.
attack_scenario.what_was_demonstrated: Confirms the technical observation exists; does not prove active exploitation.

correlated_attack_paths.title: External Service Exposure to Version/Application Control Gap on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Adversary discovers reachable network service (PORT-OPEN-21-FTP_CONTROL) on 192.168.195.139, correlates service/version telemetry (ENUM-PROTO-MYSQL-3306), and targets application/administrative control surface (DAST-ADMIN-ACCESS-EP-00028: [ADMIN-ACCESS-001] Administrative Interface Reachable (HTTP 200) on http://192.168.195.139/phpMyAdmin/). Primary Chokepoint: Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Cleartext file transfer protocol. Migrate to SFTP or FTPS.
Bind MySQL (3306/TCP) to 127.0.0.1 or restrict network access strictly to application tier hosts.
Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

correlated_attack_paths.title: Unencrypted Transport & Authentication/Session Control Chain on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Traffic served over unencrypted or non-redirecting transport (HTTP-NO-HTTPS-REDIRECT) exposes authentication or session handling (DAST-BOLA-IDOR-EP-00024: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /) and compounds browser/cookie policy gaps (ZAP-10054-10054-1). Enforcing HTTPS/HSTS breaks the chain at Step 1.

steps.summary: HTTP endpoint does not enforce HTTPS redirect
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Deploy and validate HTTPS, then redirect HTTP requests to the canonical HTTPS origin.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.summary: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Enforce server-side object-level authorization checks verifying that the authenticated caller owns the requested resource ID.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.phase: Session Token / Browser Policy Hardening Gap
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Ensure that the SameSite attribute is set to either 'lax' or ideally 'strict' for all cookies.

evidence_management.integrity_disclaimer: SHA-256 hash verifies byte-level storage integrity of the captured artifact; it does not independently prove that an observation is exploitable.

validation.test_name: Outdated Software Banner CVE & Template Verification
validation.methodology: Correlates fingerprinted software versions with Nmap NSE and Nuclei CVE verification templates.
validation.expected_result: Target enforces security control (CWE-615: Security Control Weakness) and rejects insecure configuration.
validation.actual_result: The response appears to contain suspicious comments which may help an attacker.
reproduction_steps: 1. Ensure target 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php' is within approved Rules of Engagement allowlist.
2. Issue GET request to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php'.
3. Inspect response headers/body for evidence matching: user.
4. Compare response against the expected secure control baseline.

DISCOVERED.meaning: Scanner identified a possible issue or exposed surface; runtime reproduction has not yet been performed.
DISCOVERED.exploitability_note: Observation only — does not establish that an attacker exploited or can exploit the finding.

OBSERVATION_CONFIRMED.meaning: The observed network, protocol, or HTTP response behavior was deterministically captured in a forensic transcript.
OBSERVATION_CONFIRMED.exploitability_note: Confirms the technical observation exists; does not prove active exploitation.

CONTROL_GAP_CONFIRMED.meaning: A defensive security control is demonstrably missing, weak, or misconfigured based on captured response evidence.
CONTROL_GAP_CONFIRMED.exploitability_note: Confirms a control gap was observed; it does not establish that an attacker successfully exploited it.

ATTACK_PATH_VALIDATED.meaning: A multi-step attack path combining this weakness with reachable prerequisites was validated.
ATTACK_PATH_VALIDATED.exploitability_note: Prerequisites and chaining conditions were verified.

RUNTIME_REPRODUCED.meaning: The vulnerability was actively reproduced at runtime using a deterministic non-destructive canary or probe.
RUNTIME_REPRODUCED.exploitability_note: Runtime behavior was reproduced and verified in the response transcript.

IMPACT_VERIFIED.meaning: The downstream security impact (such as unauthorized data access or execution) was directly demonstrated.
IMPACT_VERIFIED.exploitability_note: Exploitability and security impact are cryptographically proven.

REMEDIATION_VERIFIED.meaning: Subsequent retest confirmed the security control is now properly enforced.
REMEDIATION_VERIFIED.exploitability_note: Previously observed weakness has been remediated.

NOT_VULNERABLE.meaning: Testing did not establish the suspected vulnerability.

INCONCLUSIVE.meaning: Captured evidence was insufficient to confirm or rule out the issue.

BLOCKED_BY_SCOPE.meaning: Rules of Engagement (ROE) prevented active testing of this surface.
BLOCKED_BY_SCOPE.exploitability_note: Not tested due to authorization boundary.

limitations: Executed under deterministic ROE read-only safety constraints.

risk_analysis.exploitability_assessment: Control Gap / Configuration Weakness (Exploitation Not Demonstrated)
risk_analysis.business_impact: Informational or defense-in-depth hardening gap with low direct impact.

calculation_breakdown.disclaimer: TrePath Risk Priority is an internal triage metric and is never represented as an official CVSS score.

attack_scenario.prerequisites: Network reachability to http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php and ability to observe or intercept HTTP traffic on the network path.
attack_scenario.abuse_narrative: An adversary with access to http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php can leverage '[OWASP ZAP] Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments' (CWE-615) to weaken application defenses or chain with adjacent service exposures.
attack_scenario.what_was_demonstrated: Confirms the technical observation exists; does not prove active exploitation.

correlated_attack_paths.title: External Service Exposure to Version/Application Control Gap on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Adversary discovers reachable network service (PORT-OPEN-21-FTP_CONTROL) on 192.168.195.139, correlates service/version telemetry (ENUM-PROTO-MYSQL-3306), and targets application/administrative control surface (DAST-ADMIN-ACCESS-EP-00028: [ADMIN-ACCESS-001] Administrative Interface Reachable (HTTP 200) on http://192.168.195.139/phpMyAdmin/). Primary Chokepoint: Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Cleartext file transfer protocol. Migrate to SFTP or FTPS.
Bind MySQL (3306/TCP) to 127.0.0.1 or restrict network access strictly to application tier hosts.
Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

correlated_attack_paths.title: Unencrypted Transport & Authentication/Session Control Chain on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Traffic served over unencrypted or non-redirecting transport (HTTP-NO-HTTPS-REDIRECT) exposes authentication or session handling (DAST-BOLA-IDOR-EP-00024: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /) and compounds browser/cookie policy gaps (ZAP-10054-10054-1). Enforcing HTTPS/HSTS breaks the chain at Step 1.

steps.summary: HTTP endpoint does not enforce HTTPS redirect
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Deploy and validate HTTPS, then redirect HTTP requests to the canonical HTTPS origin.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.summary: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Enforce server-side object-level authorization checks verifying that the authenticated caller owns the requested resource ID.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.phase: Session Token / Browser Policy Hardening Gap
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Ensure that the SameSite attribute is set to either 'lax' or ideally 'strict' for all cookies.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

remediation.root_cause: CWE-615 (Security Control Weakness) observed on http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php.
remediation.technical_remediation: Remove all comments that return information that may help an attacker and fix any underlying problems they refer to.
implementation_steps: 1. Locate configuration or route handler serving 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php'.
2. Apply recommended control: Remove all comments that return information that may help an attacker and fix any underlying problems they refer to.
3. Deploy change to staging and verify application functionality.
4. Execute TrePath deterministic retest to confirm control enforcement.
remediation.verification_procedure: Re-issue GET probe to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php' and confirm ZAP-10027-10027 is no longer triggered.
remediation.functional_test: Verify authorized users and API clients can still access 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php' over approved transport.
remediation.negative_boundary_test: Verify unencrypted, unauthenticated, or malformed requests to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=home.php' are rejected or redirected.

references.cwe: CWE-615: Security Control Weakness

800.title: [OWASP ZAP] User Controllable HTML Element Attribute (Potential XSS)
800.proof_state_meaning: The observed network, protocol, or HTTP response behavior was deterministically captured in a forensic transcript.
800.exploitability_note: Confirms the technical observation exists; does not prove active exploitation.

overview.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
overview.affected_environment: VMware Lab Pentest Engagement (http://192.168.195.139/) (Internal Testing Lab)

technical_observation.what_trepath_observed: This check looks at user-supplied input in query string parameters and POST data to identify where certain HTML attribute values might be controlled. This provides hot-spot detection for XSS (cross-site scripting) that will require further review by a security analyst to determine exploitability.
technical_observation.expected_secure_behavior: Validate all input and sanitize output it before writing to any HTML attributes.

validation.actual_result: This check looks at user-supplied input in query string parameters and POST data to identify where certain HTML attribute values might be controlled. reproduction_steps: 1. Ensure target 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php' is within approved Rules of Engagement allowlist.
2. Issue GET request to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php' inspecting parameter/header 'page'.
3. Inspect response headers/body for evidence matching: ZAP-10031-10031.
4. Compare response against the expected secure control baseline.

attack_scenario.prerequisites: Network reachability to http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php and ability to observe or intercept HTTP traffic on the network path.
attack_scenario.abuse_narrative: An adversary with access to http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php can leverage '[OWASP ZAP] User Controllable HTML Element Attribute (Potential XSS)' (CWE-20) to weaken application defenses or chain with adjacent service exposures.
attack_scenario.what_was_demonstrated: Confirms the technical observation exists; does not prove active exploitation.

correlated_attack_paths.title: External Service Exposure to Version/Application Control Gap on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Adversary discovers reachable network service (PORT-OPEN-21-FTP_CONTROL) on 192.168.195.139, correlates service/version telemetry (ENUM-PROTO-MYSQL-3306), and targets application/administrative control surface (DAST-ADMIN-ACCESS-EP-00028: [ADMIN-ACCESS-001] Administrative Interface Reachable (HTTP 200) on http://192.168.195.139/phpMyAdmin/). Primary Chokepoint: Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Cleartext file transfer protocol. Migrate to SFTP or FTPS.
Bind MySQL (3306/TCP) to 127.0.0.1 or restrict network access strictly to application tier hosts.
Restrict administrative interfaces (/admin, :8080/manager) to internal management VPNs or bastion hosts and enforce MFA.

correlated_attack_paths.title: Unencrypted Transport & Authentication/Session Control Chain on 192.168.195.139
correlated_attack_paths.narrative: Traffic served over unencrypted or non-redirecting transport (HTTP-NO-HTTPS-REDIRECT) exposes authentication or session handling (DAST-BOLA-IDOR-EP-00024: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /) and compounds browser/cookie policy gaps (ZAP-10054-10054-1). Enforcing HTTPS/HSTS breaks the chain at Step 1.

steps.summary: HTTP endpoint does not enforce HTTPS redirect
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Deploy and validate HTTPS, then redirect HTTP requests to the canonical HTTPS origin.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.summary: [BOLA-IDOR-001] Unauthenticated Object Identifier Parameter (`id`) Accepted on /
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Enforce server-side object-level authorization checks verifying that the authenticated caller owns the requested resource ID.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

steps.phase: Session Token / Browser Policy Hardening Gap
steps.mitigation_chokepoint: Ensure that the SameSite attribute is set to either 'lax' or ideally 'strict' for all cookies.
steps.blast_radius: Authenticated User Sessions & Credentials in Transit

remediation.root_cause: CWE-20 (Improper Input Validation) observed on http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php.
remediation.technical_remediation: Validate all input and sanitize output it before writing to any HTML attributes.
implementation_steps: 1. Locate configuration or route handler serving 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php'.
2. Apply recommended control: Validate all input and sanitize output it before writing to any HTML attributes.
3. Deploy change to staging and verify application functionality.
4. Execute TrePath deterministic retest to confirm control enforcement.
remediation.verification_procedure: Re-issue GET probe to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php' and confirm ZAP-10031-10031 is no longer triggered.
remediation.functional_test: Verify authorized users and API clients can still access 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php' over approved transport.
remediation.negative_boundary_test: Verify unencrypted, unauthenticated, or malformed requests to 'http://192.168.195.139/mutillidae/index.php?page=source-viewer.php' are rejected or redirected.
